description: The order of the local entries in `extends` is load-bearing, because later packageRules override earlier ones on the same field.
`scope-fallback` sits BEFORE the shared presets so that the presets' own `github-actions` and `internal-dependencies` scopes still win where they match; it only catches what nothing else claims.

`scope-internal` and `scope-shipped` sit AFTER the presets so they can displace the preset's per-update-type commit types and its breaking-marker prefix, in that order - scope-internal normalises the whole repo to a non-releasing `chore`, then scope-shipped re-asserts release-forcing types and the `!` marker for images/** and templates/** only.
`exceptions` stays last so a per-dependency soak or hold overrides the general footprint policy.

The commit vocabulary these rules emit is enumerated in commitlint.config.js and explained in .claude/rules/commits.md; the preset pin and that enum have to move together, because two of the scopes are emitted upstream.
